purpose: One destination of a TabBar: an icon or Avatar in a pill over a short label, with an optional unread count. It is a link to a top-level page.

notFor.case: Used on its own, outside a TabBar.
A destination row in desktop navigation.
A tab that swaps a view inside the page.

Default.meaning: At rest, not the current page.
Default.visual: No pill fill; icon, media and label in Content/secondary.

Hover.visual: The pill fills Surface/muted; icon, media and label move to Content/primary.

Focused.visual: A focus ring (Border/ring/default) 1 px outside the pill; inks stay Content/secondary.

Current.meaning: The page the person is on (aria-current="page").
Current.visual: The pill fills Surface/selected; icon, media and label in Content/accent.

Disabled.meaning: Not available; aria-disabled and out of the Tab order.
Disabled.visual: No pill fill; icon, media and label in Content/disabled.

a11y.keyboard: Tab reaches it unless disabled; Enter follows the link.
notes: Minimum height is Size/target-min (44 on Tablet and Mobile).
A hidden label (hideLabel) needs an aria-label; the badge count belongs in that name (for example "Inbox, 3").
Indicator, icon and label change colour with the motion role use-hover (recipes/motion.ts).
